name: Erudite Feaster
body:
When you feed on a dead body, you gain enhanced knowledge from its remains.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, ghoul.

Benefit(s): You can maintain an additional 3 insight bonuses to skill checks gained via your feast on flesh ghoul racial ability. In addition, if the body you feast upon was particularly ancient (at least 100 years old, but well-preserved enough to still retain flesh; this can be via natural mummification or magical preservation, such as via an effect like gentle repose), you gain a +4 insight bonus to the chosen skill rather than +2.
